title: Trump threatens to ‘massively blow up’ major Iranian gas field
byline: US President Donald Trump has just issued a long Truth social post about the attack on the South Pars oil field in Iran, saying the US ‘‘knew nothing’’ of the Israeli attack - and threatening an escalation if Iran retaliates against Qatar again.

title: Pentagon is seeking more than $200bn for Iran war – report
byline: The Pentagon has asked the White house to approve more than $200bn (£151bn) in order to fund the war in Iran, a senior administration official has told the Washington Post.

title: New feature introduced to resolve issues during vehicle QR code re-registration
byline: A new feature has been added to the system starting today (19) to address the difficulties faced by the public when trying to obtain the QR code of a previously registered vehicle, especially in cases where the mobile phone number used for the original registration is no longer in use.

title: Fairly heavy showers expected in parts of the island today
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm, today (19), the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Qatar says Iran attacked LNG hub; UAE shuts gas facilities
byline: Qatar’s state oil giant QatarEnergy said on Wednesday that Iranian missile attacks on Ras Laffan, the site of the country’s core LNG processing operations, caused “extensive damage”, while the UAE shut gas facilities after intercepting missiles early on Thursday.

title: President Anura Kumara and Qatar Amir discuss regional developments and bilateral concerns
byline: The Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al-Thani of Qatar has received a phone call from President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Anura Kumara Dissanayake, to discuss regional developments and bilateral concerns.

title: Fuel distribution to follow ‘odd-even’ number plate system starting today
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has announced that, starting today (19), fuel quotas issued through the QR system will be distributed based on the last digit of the vehicle number plate.

title: No-confidence motion against Energy Minister to be submitted to Speaker today
byline: A motion of no-confidence against Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody, signed by opposition Members of Parliament, will be handed over to the Speaker of Parliament today (19).

title: TV Derana’s Chathura Alwis wins ‘People’s TV Presenter of the Year Award’ for 8th consecutive year
byline: TV Derana’s Chathura Alwis has been once again honoured as the People’s Television Presenter of the Year at the 2026 SLIM-KANTAR People’s Awards.

title: Macron calls for halt to strikes on civilian infrastructure
byline: French President Emmanuel Macron says that there must be ‘‘a moratorium’‘ on strikes that target civilian infrastructure, following the attacks on areas that produce gas in Iran and Qatar.

title: Oil nears $110 a barrel after gas field strike
byline: Oil prices leapt to nearly $110 a barrel after Iranian media reported an airstrike hitting a facility on the world’s largest natural gas field.

title: Saudi Arabia says reserves right to respond after Iran attacks Riyadh, east
byline: Saudi Arabia reiterated that its immediate priority in the ongoing Iran conflict is to halt attacks targeting Gulf countries, with Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud stressing that the Kingdom is focused on protecting regional stability, Al Jazeera reported.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for several provinces for tomorrow
byline: A warm weather advisory has been issued for residents of the Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-Central, Southern, North-Western provinces and Monaragala, Mannar, Vavuniya, and Mullaitivu districts.

title: Govt introduces new fuel management system to support fisheries sector
byline: The Secretary to the Ministry of Fisheries, Aquatic, and Ocean Resources, Dr. B. K. Kolita Kamal Jinadasa, has announced the implementation of a new fuel management system aimed at ensuring the continued sustainability of the fisheries sector.

title: Public advised to resolve QR code issues before visiting filling stations
byline: The Filling Station Owners’ Association has advised the general public to resolve any issues related to their QR codes prior to visiting filling stations, with the regulation being enforced strictly from today (18).

title: Australia announces temporary travel ban for specified group of visitors
byline: Australia has introduced a new legislation under the Migration Amendment (2026 Measures No. 1) Act 2026, allowing a temporary ban for a specified group of travellers to travel to the country during international crises.

title: Duo arrested with over 10kg of ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: Two Sri Lankans have been arrested at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) this morning while attempting to smuggle a stock of ‘Kush’ cannabis worth Rs. 105 million into the country.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-Central, Southern, Uva, North-Western provinces and Mannar district.

title: Naval escorts could make tankers a target for Iran, warns UN maritime chief
byline: Naval escorts will not guarantee safe passage for oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz and could even present a target for Iran as it attempts to leverage control of the vital shipping lane, the head of the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) has warned.

title: Public warned on emerging online financial scams exploiting names of reputable institutions
byline: Sri Lanka Police states that despite continuous public awareness efforts regarding fraudulent activities and financial crimes carried out through the internet and modern technology, the number of complaints related to such scams is steadily increasing.

title: Ministry issues directive on fuel allocation registration for tourism sector
byline: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment, and Tourism has issued an official announcement outlining the registration process for obtaining fuel allocations for the tourism industry.

title: Drone attack targets US embassy in Baghdad
byline: A drone attack targeted the U.S. embassy in Baghdad and an explosion was heard in the area, security sources said early on Wednesday, a day after a series of ⁠strikes.

title: INTERPOL: 45,000 malicious IP addresses taken down in international cyber operation
byline: An international cybercrime operation targeting phishing, malware and ransomware has seen the INTERPOL take down more than 45,000 malicious IP addresses and servers, the organisation has announced.

title: Minister assures uninterrupted fuel supply to operators in tourism industry
byline: The Deputy Minister of Tourism, Prof. Ruwan Ranasinghe has assured that the tourism industry will remain safeguarded against any potential fuel disruptions affecting other sectors of the country.

title: ‘War upon our shores’: Namal calls Indian Ocean the new global ‘economic highway,’ warns of global system collapse
byline: Sri Lankan MP Namal Rajapaksa, speaking at WION’s World Pulse summit on Wednesday (Mar 18), said the global system is undergoing a major transformation, adding that “global institutions are being tested like never before.”

title: Two killed in Iranian strike on Tel Aviv
byline: Two people have been killed during an Iranian missile attack that struck “several” sites around Tel Aviv, local police said.

title: Israel extends re-entry visas for Sri Lankans and overseas workers
byline: Visas of workers who have left Israel for vacation or other purposes have been extended until April 30, 2026, Sri Lanka’s Ambassador to Israel, Nimal Bandara stated.

title: Oil prices drop as Iraqi and Kurdish authorities agree to export deal
byline: Oil prices eased on Wednesday to pare back some of Tuesday’s sharp gains after the Iraqi government and Kurdish authorities reached a deal to resume oil exports via Turkey’s Ceyhan port, providing modest relief to concerns about Middle East supplies.

title: Four killed, 40 injured following accident involving two buses in Weerawila
byline: At least four individuals have been killed in a head-on collision involving two buses along the Ambalantota–Kataragama road in Weerawila, police stated.

title: Brazil starts to restrict minors’ access to social media
byline: Brazil began implementing new measures on Tuesday (Mar 17) to restrict minors’ access to social media and prevent them from viewing violent or illegal content.

title: Concerns raised over placing burden of inferior coal costs on the public
byline: The Deputy President of the National Chamber of Commerce of Sri Lanka (NCCSL), Dr. Lakmal Fernando, stated that imposing the burden from the losses caused by inferior quality coal on the general public is an illegal act.

title: No-confidence motion against Energy Minister to be submitted to Speaker tomorrow
byline: A motion of no-confidence against Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody, signed by opposition Members of Parliament, will be handed over to the Speaker of Parliament tomorrow (19).

title: Vehicle parking fees in Colombo suspended until further notice – CMC
byline: The Colombo Municipal Council (CMC) has announced the suspension of vehicle parking fee collection across its jurisdiction until further notice.

title: Sri Lanka to dispense fuel for vehicles on ‘odd–even’ basis
byline: Owners of vehicles will be allowed to purchase fuel under an odd–even number plate system from today (19), according to the Managing Director of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), Dr. Mayura Neththikumarage.

title: Australian facilities damaged in Iranian attack on Middle East air base
byline: Iran has launched an attack on an air base in the Middle East where Australian soldiers are stationed, starting a fire that damaged Australian medical and accommodation facilities.

title: US judge orders Trump administration to reopen Voice of America
byline: A judge in the US has ruled that the effective closure of the Voice of America (VOA) last year was “illegal” and that hundreds of its journalists should be reinstated.

title: Air Force warns against unauthorized drone use
byline: Both local and foreign nationals have been warned against operating drones within Sri Lanka without proper authorization, the Sri Lanka Air Force (SLAF) has announced.

title: Longest extra-wide Bailey Bridge installed by India in Sri Lanka inaugurated
byline: A 240-foot Bailey Bridge on the Chilaw–Thoduwawa Road, connecting the coastal villages of Thoduwawa and Iranawila, was inaugurated today (18) under India’s post-Ditwah reconstruction assistance programme.

title: Two LP gas ships arrive in Sri Lanka
byline: Two liquefied petroleum gas carriers docked this morning (18) at the Thaldiyawatta gas unloading jetty in Uswetakeiyawa.

title: WhatsApp service introduced to register for National Fuel Pass
byline: The Ministry of Digital Economy has introduced a special WhatsApp number to assist with registering for the National Fuel Pass (QR code).

title: Actions underway to launch Grade 6 educational reforms in 2027
byline: Steps have been taken to monitor the progress of the new education reform process introduced for Grade One, according to the Prime Minister’s Media Division.

title: China vows stronger law enforcement cooperation with Sri Lanka to curb online fraud
byline: China has reaffirmed its strong commitment to cracking down on telecommunications and online fraud, while pledging to further strengthen law enforcement cooperation with Sri Lanka.

title: Iranian intelligence minister killed, Israel says
byline: Iran’s intelligence minister, Esmaeil Khatib, has been killed overnight, according to the Israeli defence minister, Israel Katz.

title: Iran’s army chief threatens ‘decisive’ retaliation for killing of Larijani
byline: Iranian army chief Amir Hatami has threatened to launch a “decisive” retaliation for the killing of security chief Ali Larijani in an Israeli air strike.

title: US Special Envoy Sergio Gor arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: U.S. Special Envoy for South and Central Asia, Sergio Gor, has arrived in Sri Lanka for an official visit, according to the US Embassy in Colombo.

title: No-confidence motion against Energy Minister submitted to Speaker
byline: The no-confidence motion against Energy Minister Kumara Jayakody signed by Opposition Members of Parliament (MPs) has been handed over to the Speaker, a short while ago.

title: Arab nations condemn Iran’s ‘deliberate attacks’ in joint statement
byline: Arab nations have issued a joint statement in response to Iran’s attacks, following a meeting of foreign affairs ministers in Riyadh on Wednesday.

title: Cathay Pacific suspends all flights to Dubai and Riyadh
byline: Airline Cathay Pacific has cancelled all flights to and from Dubai and Riyadh up until 30 April, which it says is a result of the ‘‘developing situation’’ in the Middle East.

title: Pop Mart and Sony team up for Labubu film to expand viral toy’s reach
byline: Labubu’s toothy grin will be coming to the big screen after toy maker Pop Mart and Sony Pictures Entertainment announced plans to develop a feature film based on the ugly-cute monster.

title: Oil jumps 4% as strikes continue
byline: The price of Brent crude shot up by 4% to $112 (£84.34) a barrel in early trade in Asia.

title: All April fuel shipments confirmed; No fuel supply issues – CPC
byline: The Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC) has explained that all fuel orders relevant to the month of April were confirmed yesterday (18).

title: Former SriLankan CEO Kapila Chandrasena further remanded
byline: Former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of SriLankan Airlines, Kapila Chandrasena, who was arrested over a bribery allegation, has been further remanded until April 02 by the Colombo Magistrate’s Court.

title: Businessman arrested for illegally hoarding over 600L petrol in Polonnaruwa
byline: A businessman has been arrested in the Meegaswewa area of Polonnaruwa for illegally hoarding 604 litres of petrol without a valid license.

title: QR code-related issues for fuel to be resolved by tomorrow - Minister Bimal
byline: Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development Bimal Rathnayake says that issues faced by the public in obtaining QR codes for fuel will be addressed within today (19), and are expected to be fully resolved by tomorrow (20).

title: Sri Lanka reports 8,500–9,500 TB cases annually, Western Province most affected
byline: The National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Diseases (NPTCCD) has reported that Sri Lanka records between 8,500 and 9,500 tuberculosis (TB) cases each year.

title: British Airways to resume flights to Colombo
byline: British Airways has announced that it will resume flights to Colombo in October.

title: Adani’s Colombo Terminal handles over 1 million containers in first year
byline: A rapid first-year ramp-up at the Port of Colombo in Sri Lanka underscores the expanding global footprint of India’s Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ), highlighting both the growing importance of the Indian Ocean region in global trade flows and its emerging role in the blue economy.

title: Banks to maintain uninterrupted services; public urged to use digital channels
byline: The Sri Lanka Banks’ Association (SLBA) has assured the public that banks will continue to operate on all five weekdays as an essential service, despite the temporary measures introduced to conserve fuel and energy resources.

title: FBI reportedly investigating former US counterterrorism chief who resigned over Iran war
byline: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is investigating former counterterrorism official Joe Kent, who resigned in protest over the Iran war, US media reported Wednesday.

title: Court urges amicable settlement in petition filed by ex-Deputy Sec. Gen of Parliament
byline: The Court of Appeal of Sri Lanka has directed both parties to consider the possibility of reaching an amicable settlement in the petition filed by former Deputy Secretary General of Parliament, Chaminda Kularatne.

title: Ex-SriLankan CEO claims Rs. 60 mln in Airbus bribes paid to ex-President Mahinda: court told
byline: The Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) today (19) has informed the Colombo Magistrate’s Court that it has been uncovered that funds allegedly received as bribes from the Airbus aircraft deal had been handed over by former SriLankan Airlines CEO, Kapila Chandrasena to former President Mahinda Rajapaksa...

title: Iran’s envoy to UN blames UAE for providing territory to US for attacks
byline: Iran’s UN envoy, Amir Saeid Iravani, has formally notified the UN Secretary-General and Security Council that the UAE is ‘‘internationally responsible’‘ for providing its territory to the US for attacks, reported state Media.

title: Iran considers levying transit fees on ships in Hormuz Strait, lawmaker says
byline: Iran is considering a proposal to levy transit fees on vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz, a lawmaker said on Thursday, a potential bid to monetise Tehran’s newfound grip over the critical waterway through which a fifth of global oil and liquefied gas passes.

title: US Special Envoy calls on Sri Lanka President to discuss bilateral ties and regional developments
byline: The United States Special Representative for South and Central Asia, and US Ambassador to India, Sergio Gor, who is currently visiting Sri Lanka, met with President Anura Kumara Dissanayake this morning (19) at the Presidential Secretariat.

title: Parliament to debate no-confidence motion against Energy Minister on April 10
byline: The Parliamentary Business Committee has decided to hold the debate on a no-confidence motion against Minister of Energy Kumara Jayakody on April 10, according to the Department of Communications of Parliament.

title: Eid-ul-Fitr to be celebrated in Sri Lanka on Saturday
byline: The Muslim community of Sri Lanka will celebrate ‘Eid-ul-Fitr’ festival on Saturday (21), as the new crescent moon for the month of ‘Shawwal’ was not sighted today (19), according to the Colombo Grand Mosque.

title: SriLankan Airlines and govt finalise $175 million bond restructuring
byline: SriLankan Airlines and the Government of Sri Lanka have completed the airline’s international bond restructuring with over 99% participation, marking a key step in the national carrier’s recovery.

title: World Happiness Report 2026: Sri Lanka ranked among world’s unhappiest countries
byline: Sri Lanka has been ranked among the least happy countries globally, with the island nation’s rankling dropping one place to 134th, according to the World Happiness Report 2026, published on Thursday.

title: Iran intensifies attacks on oil and gas facilities in Gulf after Israeli strike on key gas field
byline: Iran intensified its attacks on oil and gas facilities around the Gulf on Thursday, dramatically raising the stakes in a war that is sending shock waves through the global economy.

title: US objectives in Iran have not changed, Hegseth says
byline: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday that the United States’ objectives in the war against Iran have not changed since strikes started on February 28.

title: New hotline for resolving issues related to National Fuel Pass
byline: The Ministry of Digital Economy has announced the launch of a dedicated support service to promptly resolve technical issues and registration difficulties faced by users of the National Fuel Pass system.

title: IMF team to visit Sri Lanka next week for policy talks, combined reviews
byline: An International Monetary Fund (IMF) team is scheduled to visit Sri Lanka from March 26 to April 9 to hold policy discussions and aims to complete the combined 5th and 6th reviews, according to Julie Kozack, Director of the Communications Department of the IMF.

title: Former President Ranil recovering after successful surgery - UNP
byline: The Chairman of the United National Party (UNP), Vajira Abeywardena, has issued a statement clarifying that former President Ranil Wickremesinghe is recovering following a successful surgery at a hospital in Singapore.
